name: Amayo ~Sougetsu Miko Zoushi~
source:
Captured by greasy tentacles, absorbed by explosive ecstasy, she reminded something...
An innocent girl in clean uniform of a shrine maiden is violated as she tries to escape.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE015107.html]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
被滑腻的触手束缚、被骤然涌来的快感淹没时，她想起了某件事……
身穿洁净巫女服的纯真少女试图逃脱，却遭到了侵犯。

[编译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE015107.html]Dlsite[/url]]
